name: Extended Net
source: Sancai Tuhui (1609), Niaoshou (birds and beasts) chapters 1-4, plate '鹿 (deer)'; National Diet Library copy 三才圖會 106卷 [26], frame 107
treatment: genuine cut-out: a stag rearing round, antlers high, its coat spotted
fit: placed over the group: centred on its stars, upright, 12 deg on its larger side; no star tied
subject: 張月鹿, the deer of the mansion Zhang: the encyclopaedia's deer
honesty: The stag's near fore hoof is cut off by the page frame in the 1609 print.
subject_role_note: the mansion's animal in the traditional 28-animal series (二十八宿禽星): deer (鹿), the plate's own subject
